name: Xingang Meeting Management
description: Query, search and maintain meeting minutes and key tracking items in the meeting management system with your own account.
configuration.meeting_base_url.label: Meeting system URL
configuration.meeting_base_url.descripti: Directory that serves the meeting system index.html, for example http://10.6.80.241:8091/meeting
configuration.search_base_url.label: Search service URL
configuration.search_base_url.descriptio: Search service used by the content search page, for example http://10.6.80.35:9500
authorization.title: Authorize with your meeting system account
authorization.description: Enter the single sign-on account (employee number) and password you use for the meeting system. Authorization signs in once and reads your account profile; the connector signs in again automatically whenever the system reports that the session expired.
authorization.username.label: Account
authorization.username.description: Single sign-on account, usually your employee number
authorization.password.label: Password
authorization.password.description: Single sign-on password, stored encrypted by POCO
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.meetings.title: Meeting query
capabilities.meetings.description: List meeting minutes by date range and meeting type, including content, attendees, supervision items and edit history.
capabilities.search.title: Content search
capabilities.search.description: Search meeting content, supervision items or attendees by keyword, optionally limited by dates, meeting type and supervision type.
capabilities.manage.title: Meeting maintenance
capabilities.manage.description: Create, update and delete meeting minutes. Content is rendered in the system's numbered section format, and types, locations and people are checked against the system dictionaries.
capabilities.tracking.title: Key tracking items
capabilities.tracking.description: Query key tracking items and due items by proposer level, responsible unit, status and more; authorized accounts can create, update, complete and delete them.
limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Writes and deletions require confirmation and are never retried automatically. Meeting supervision items and attachments are read-only through the connector; existing supervision items are kept when a meeting is updated. Key tracking item maintenance is limited to accounts authorized in the meeting system.
examples.title: Examples
examples.query.title: Query meetings
examples.query.description: Show this week's ironmaking internal meetings and list every item assigned to the work areas.
examples.search.title: Search content
examples.search.description: Search last month's meetings for anything about winter production.
examples.create.title: Record a meeting
examples.create.description: Turn these notes into today's meeting system test meeting.
